raw: “I grind my coffee by hand every morning. That’s the part that comes to mind first, turning the handle and feeling the beans break down. It’s repetitive, but I like having something simple to do while I’m waking up. The smell makes me think of the coffee before I’ve even finished grinding it. And then I start thinking about work—I’m a cashier at a lighting store. It’s funny, thinking about lights when you’re still trying to wake up. But the coffee is what I think of as my morning routine. I’ve wandered over to work now, haven’t I?”
